The original claim, unchanged, follows. --- spec/target-spec.md#temp-vt-transfer -- design-intent slope and output range for the PTAT/CTAT pads, the row target-spec.md tags [TBD-#9] and this issue owns. Also substantiates, at the systematic level only: #temp-accuracy-untrimmed (+/-3 C), #temp-supply-sensitivity (<=0.5 C/V, i.e. <=0.33 C over the +/-10 % window), #temp-iq (<20 uA) and #temp-trim-strategy (1-point 25 C gain trim -- range and LSB measured here).
